rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for “or else” or a contrary condition.

example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 nei5 zau6 ci4 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when something is true in all other respects apart from the point just mentioned.

example.english: Otherwise, this phone is pretty good.
example.traditional: 其他方面，呢部電話都幾好。
example.jyutping: kei4 taa1 fong1 min6 ni1 bou6 din6 waa6 dou1 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this when “otherwise” means doing something by a different method or in a different way.

example.english: Let's do it otherwise and not repeat the old way.
example.traditional: 我哋換個方法做，唔好再照舊喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wun6 go3 fong1 faat3 zou6 m4 hou2 zoi3 ziu3 gau6 laa3
